title: Do They Understand Them? An Updated Evaluation on Nonbinary Pronoun Handling in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of Large Language Models in correctly using and resolving diverse pronoun forms (binary, gender-neutral, and neopronouns like xe/xem) in cloze-style sentence completion tasks using the MISGENDERED+ benchmark.

A 'Gender Identity Inference' task that tests whether models prioritize explicit pronoun cues or default to name-based gender stereotypes when inferring a subject's gender identity, particularly in mismatched conditions (e.g., a masculine name with neopronouns).
